jobs.title: Solution Architect/Data Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Solution Architect & Data Engineer to help design, build, and scale a strategic market analytics platform serving the global aerospace aftermarket. This role blends solution architecture, data engineering, analytics, and stakeholder engagement. The successful candidate will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions while remaining hands-on in the development of data pipelines, data models, analytics products, and AI-enabled capabilities. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable discussing business strategy with stakeholders, designing system architecture, and writing production-quality code.

This position is based at our Corporate Headquarters in Wood Dale, IL, with a planned relocation to the Merchandise Mart (Chicago) in early 2027.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Define the overall architecture and technical roadmap for advanced analytics platforms.
Design scalable data, integration, analytics, and AI solutions.
Establish standards for data models, APIs, governance, security, and platform design.
Balance immediate business needs with long-term maintainability and scalability.
Build and maintain data pipelines that ingest, transform, and integrate data from multiple internal and external sources.
Design and implement scalable data models for reporting, analytics, and AI applications.
Develop data products, dashboards, and analytical datasets that support business decision-making.
Ensure data quality, reliability, performance, and operational supportability.
Partner with business users to deliver actionable insights and measurable outcomes.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and automation.
Develop and deploy data assets that support forecasting, market intelligence, and decision-support capabilities.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to platform capabilities.
Work closely with commercial, operations, and technology stakeholders to understand business needs.
Translate business problems into technical solutions and prioritized delivery plans.
Communicate architecture, tradeoffs, and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences.

What You Need To Be Successful In This Role

7+ years of experience in data engineering, solution architecture, analytics engineering, or related roles.
Strong experience designing and building cloud-based data analytics solutions.
Hands-on experience with: Advanced Analytical SQL | PySpark/Python | Java Spring boot framework | Data integration and ETL/ELT development (Spark/Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka, and cloud-native services) | Data modeling and warehousing | APIs and system integrations.
Experience with modern analytics and business intelligence platforms. Provide technical direction and oversight across data pipelines, modeling, APIs, infrastructure, and UI interaction patterns without directly owning implementation.
Ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Azure data and analytics services.
Experience building analytics, forecasting, or AI-enabled solutions.
Familiarity with aerospace, manufacturing, supply chain, or industrial businesses.
Experience working in both architecture and hands-on engineering roles.
Experience building data products from concept through production deployment.

Success Measures

Delivers trusted and scalable analytics solutions.
Accelerates access to meaningful business insights.
Establishes reusable data and analytics capabilities that reduce future development effort.
Improves the speed and quality of business decision-making.
Drives measurable business value through analytics, machine learning, and AI.

Ideal Candidate

A pragmatic technologist who enjoys building as much as designing. They understand architecture, but they are not afraid to write code, troubleshoot data pipelines, or create analytical products themselves. They focus on business outcomes, move quickly, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between short-term delivery and long-term scalability.

The rewards of your career at AAR go far beyond just your salary:

Competitive salary and bonus package
Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
401(k) retirement plan with company match
Generous paid time off program
Professional development and career advancement opportunities

Physical Demands/Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required to sit, stand, bend, reach and move about the facility.
The environmental characteristic for this position is an office setting.
Candidates should be able to adapt to a traditional business environment.

AAR provides accommodation in accordance with applicable laws through all stages of the hiring process. If you require accommodation for any part of the application and/or hiring process, please advise Human Resources.

Compensation

The anticipated salary range for this position is $150,000 to $170,000
annually. This range reflects the base salary for candidates who meet the requirements of the role, including experience, education, and location. In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for a bonus.
AAR offers a competitive benefits package, including medical/dental/vision/life/and AD&D insurance, 401(k) savings plan with employer match, paid time off and holiday pay, as well as opportunities for professional development and growth.

jobs.title: Workday Reporting Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Workday Reporting Analyst

Position Overview

Our client is seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to support a major HR systems transformation as the organization migrates from PeopleSoft to Workday.

This role will partner closely with HR stakeholders, technical teams, and external implementation partners, including Accenture, to ensure Workday reporting and analytics are fully prepared for deployment. The analyst will also provide reporting support during the post-deployment hypercare period.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience building Workday reports, working with large datasets, validating data accuracy, and identifying discrepancies with precision. Workday expertise is essential; experience with Workday Prism Analytics is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, configure, and maintain Workday reports and dashboards to support HR and business requirements.

Partner with HR, IT, and Accenture teams to gather reporting requirements and translate them into effective Workday solutions.

Support PeopleSoft-to-Workday data validation, reconciliation, and reporting readiness activities.

Analyze large and complex datasets to identify data mismatches, inconsistencies, missing information, and reporting issues.

Perform data quality checks and investigate discrepancies across employee, organizational, compensation, benefits, and other HR data.

Support report testing, validation, defect resolution, and deployment activities.

Prepare reporting documentation, data validation results, issue logs, and status updates.

Assist with Workday deployment readiness and provide reporting and analytics support during hypercare.

Collaborate with stakeholders to troubleshoot reporting issues and deliver timely, accurate solutions.

Ensure reports align with business requirements, data governance standards, and security guidelines.

Required Qualifications

Hands-on experience building and maintaining reports in Workday.

Experience working with large datasets and performing detailed data analysis and reconciliation.

Strong understanding of HR data, reporting concepts, and data quality practices.

Ability to identify, investigate, and resolve data mismatches accurately.

Experience supporting system implementations, migrations, testing, deployment, or hypercare activities.

Strong SQL, Excel, or comparable data analysis skills.

Excellent attention to detail and analytical problem-solving abilities.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with HR, IT, and external partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Workday Prism Analytics.

Experience supporting a PeopleSoft-to-Workday migration.

Familiarity with Workday security, calculated fields, report fields, and data sources.

Experience with Workday Studio, EIBs, integrations, or related HR technology tools.

Previous experience working with large-scale HR transformation programs.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Contract

Industries

Information Technology & Services
